h: Round off a day in town
p: Lymelight Boulevard sits on the High Street, so everything Newcastle-under-Lyme's town centre has to offer is a few minutes' walk away. That makes Reel Games a handy rainy-day fallback or a reward after a morning's shopping, especially with bowling, the cinema and food all under the same roof.

If you want to stretch it into a full day, the Potteries are right on the doorstep: Stoke-on-Trent's pottery museums are a short drive, and Trentham Estate, with its gardens, lakeside walks and Monkey Forest, is only a few miles south. It's a cracking combo for families who want a bit of fresh air before the arcade.
